purpose: Give an authoritative instruction using an older command form.
keywords: First, calm down and tell me what happened.
Ask freely if there is anything you do not understand.
restrictions: Often heard in fiction or speech from a superior; can sound condescending.
mistake: For ordinary polite requests, use てください.
